newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Cricket-Australia declare on 312 for four v West Indies.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Australia declare on 312 for four v West Indies.

text.p: Australia captain Mark Taylor set West Indies a winning target of 340 when he declared his side's second innings closed on 312 for four late on the fourth day of the second test on Monday.
Greg Blewett was 47 not out and Ian Healy 12 when Taylor brought his side's innings to a close. Australia will now have 14 overs to bowl at West Indies before the close of play.
Michael Bevan was the only batsman dismissed in the third session, caught behind by Courtney Browne from Kenneth Benjamin's bowling for 52.
Mark Waugh was out for 67 in the afternoon session after opener Matthew Elliott retired hurt on 78 shortly before lunch.
Ian Bishop was West Indies' best bowler with 2-54 from 20 overs.
